hidden_objection_layers_add.text: A man came to the house in September and asked her how she would describe a night in the autumn, before that night had happened.

second_delayed_cost.text: Anna Voss has instructed a lawyer and will not take your calls.

a1.line: The police left at nine. Before you start: he was home, and I am not going to cry about it in front of you.

tells.reading: Held long enough for the ash to be cold.
tells.false_positive: She smokes. The hand is busy.

tells.anchor: phrase:not going to cry about it in front of you
tells.reading: She has put a price on any gentleness you try next.
tells.false_positive: She is exhausted and warning you off. That is allowed.

tells.reading: Home, not here. She placed him, not herself, and she did it before you asked.
tells.false_positive: People say home for here. It is the ordinary word.

choices_add.text: He was home. You did not say you were. Where were you?
Nobody asked you to cry. Why is that the first thing in the room?

a2.line: Then have it. He was home, we ate, I washed up. Ask the neighbour. Ask the man downstairs.

tells.reading: The thumb goes across the ring on the word home, the same as last time.
tells.false_positive: A widow touching a ring. Eleven days.

tells.reading: She is sending you to people who were not in this kitchen.

line_by_state.line: [The cigarette goes down on the saucer and stays.] Ask me the question you came with.
I was not fooled. I was busy. Everyone keeps getting those two confused.
My husband was home. Write it down or do not.
In September a man sat where you are. He asked how I would describe a night in the autumn. He did not say which night.
It went up in September. I thought you had sent it. He said four of you agreed something, and one kept it.

choices_add.text: Not the face. What did he do with his hands?

line_by_state.line: He turned a lighter over and over and he did not smoke. [She looks at him. First time tonight.] He is in that photograph.
[She looks at him. First time tonight.] They will ask what he was like. I will have to say I do not know. That will be true.
He did not say which one. He said you would know, and that you would come here first.
